name: document
label: Document Intelligence Source Plan
purpose: Guide safe local analysis and provenance-preserving document review.

prohibited: uploading sensitive files to unapproved services

steps.evidence_requirement: Record filename, acquisition context and hash where feasible.
steps.stop_condition: Do not continue until the original is preserved.

steps.goal: Inspect metadata, structure, OCR and residual content locally where possible.
steps.evidence_requirement: Tie every extracted value to file, location/page and analysis method.
steps.stop_condition: Stop if analysis requires unsafe execution or unnecessary disclosure.

steps.goal: Corroborate candidate pivots using independent public sources.
steps.evidence_requirement: Do not treat extracted metadata as identity proof.
steps.stop_condition: Stop when pivots are corroborated or remain explicitly unresolved.
